name: RateAvailabilityCalendar
tagline: Hotel rates, inventory and restrictions in one Power Apps grid – with suggestions, approvals and an ARI export.
description: A complete hotel revenue (ARI) app for Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages: room type × night rate grid with inline editing, availability and restriction modes, month view, occupancy KPIs (ADR, RevPAR), stop sell / CTA / CTD / min-max stay, derived rate plans, occupancy-based rate suggestions within floors and ceilings, hierarchy and overbooking checks, bulk updates, four-eyes approval and publishing with a channel-manager CSV.
features: Inline rate editing with keyboard navigation
Rate floors and ceilings per room type
Stop sell, CTA, CTD, min / max stay
Bulk update by selection or date range
Demo mode with a fictional hotel
Phone agenda view and bottom navigation
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field control)
